boundary: Whole-value labels concern only supplied finite text contexts. Supported requires the projected factual clauses to be licensed by that context; qualifications may preserve unreported implementation details. Not established does not mean false or absent paper-globally. Contradicted requires explicit incompatibility. No prior production review is treated as truth. These labels are model-authored diagnostic candidates, not expert gold.

cases.rationale: The supplied methods and Figure S11 caption establish the reported pulse durations, culture conditions, two PBS washes, uridine chase and samples at the listed chase times. They do not establish physically separate prelabelled cultures rather than serial sampling or aliquots, or categorically rule out sequential harvests of the same material for the separately described pulse durations. The unchanged workflow projection includes those stronger sampling-origin statements. Its complete value is therefore not established by this finite context; this does not show the statements false in the original experiments or full publication.

The source reports biotinylated linker I, MmeI digestion, streptavidin-bead enrichment and subsequent linker II ligation. It does not specify a 20 μL water elution at 70°C for five minutes. The complete value is not established by the supplied context; absence of an elution recipe does not establish that no elution occurred.

This value retains the baseline sampling-origin assertions: physically separate prelabelled cultures and a categorical exclusion of sequential harvests, neither established by the supplied finite context. It additionally asserts complete intracellular s4U nucleotide-pool clearance after two PBS washes; the supplied methods report those washes and 10 mM uridine chase but do not measure or establish that clearance. The whole value is not established, not contradicted. Because its unmodified counterpart is also not established, whole-value label scoring cannot isolate the effect of this seeded clearance mutation.

The supplied mechanism passage explicitly identifies covalent addition of a carboxyamidomethyl group to the thiol-containing nucleotide, followed by altered RT-directed incorporation in primer extension/sequencing. The value instead states that IAA covalently replaces s4U with cytidine. Group addition and base replacement are different chemical transformations; the source directly contradicts the asserted replacement mechanism.

The source specifies approximately 108 bp 454 tags, trimming to at least fifty continuous high-quality bases beginning at the 5′ end, BLAT with >85% alignment/>70% coverage and a five-base gap allowance, and retention of unique genomic positions. Nearby supplement text explicitly explains missing DNase-seq signal from nonunique alignment in recent segmental duplications, supporting the qualified absence interpretation.

The supplied PCR passage explains monitoring to reduce GC and size bias and stop before saturation. It does not establish identical efficiency for every fragment. The rest of the record describes the documented aliquot/main-reaction handoff; the unsupported guarantee makes the complete value not established in this finite context, without proving it false paper-globally.

The supplied methods specify a typical five micrograms of cellular total RNA, the general 5–50 µg range, 10 mM IAA/50% DMSO/50 mM sodiumphosphate pH8 for fifteen minutes at fifty degrees, excess-DTT quenching and subsequent ethanol precipitation/Quant-seq handoff. The mechanism passage distinguishes thiol derivatization from RT-mediated conversion. Labeled and unlabeled controls remain separate; the acid stop in free-nucleoside mass spectrometry and the synthetic-oligo control recipe are not substituted for the cellular workflow.

The supplied coordinate-method passage specifies +4 bp for plus-strand reads and −5 bp for minus-strand reads. The value reverses both signs. This is an explicit incompatibility, not a lack-of-evidence inference. The same single coordinate-rule mutation is repeated in its operation and output-state description to keep the record internally consistent.

The same primary methods passage assigns Mummer to 20 bp Illumina tags and BLAT to the approximately 108 bp 454 tags after trimming. The value instead assigns Mummer to the 454 alignment operation. Operation name, action and software resource are changed together as one platform-specific tool substitution, with no residual BLAT wording in the candidate record; the source directly contradicts it.

The source explicitly places linker I ligation before MmeI digestion and bead enrichment, with the biotinylated/phosphorylated sequences and a 3′ MmeI site. The projected record preserves source cleavage-end lineage and distinguishes the digest from the selected bead fraction. The separate overhang/T4 account is retained as a qualification rather than silently fixing its placement.

The PCR passage explicitly gives five initial cycles, an aliquot with added Sybr Green cocktail, twenty monitoring cycles, the retained 45 μL main reaction, stopping before saturation and the observed 10–12 total cycles. The projected states distinguish sampled material, retained material and cycle-control information; they do not claim a numerical threshold or fixed universal cycle count.

The supplied methods report hg19/BOWTIE with -X2000/-m1, Picard duplicate removal, and the strand-specific +4/−5 bp coordinate transformation for peak calling and footprinting. The paired-end/insert-distribution and footprint passages support preserving physical fragment lengths separately from inferred insertion centers and treating occupancy as an inference. The supplement supplies local insertion preference and the differing peak-correlation wording.
